maximal_existence_scope: For every x0 in open D and autonomous locally Lipschitz f:D→E, in a complete real normed space, constructs a positive EReal endpoint and actual D-valued forward ODE solution with initial x0 and genuine no-longer-real-time-extension maximality. This is derived from local Picard existence and Zorn, not supplied as a hypothesis.
maximal_existence_construction: ForwardSolution stores positive EReal endpoint, path, initial value, D-valuedness, and actual HasDerivWithinAt on forwardTimeDomain endpoint.
Extends requires endpoint inclusion and equality of the whole old trajectory.

A nonempty chain has an actual upper bound at the endpoint supremum, with a choice trajectory. Chain comparability yields path agreement on each old domain. Local domain membership and agreement transfer the actual ODE derivative to the supremum domain.
Local existence supplies a nonempty ForwardSolution type. Zorn gives a maximal member. A longer real-domain actual solution preserving old trajectory contradicts maximality by endpoint order.
global_existence_scope: In finite-dimensional real normed space, defines actual forward invariance of C over all true ForwardSolution paths starting in C. For compact C subset open D, invariance plus locally Lipschitz f gives actual global forward solution existence from every C point. If such compact invariant subsets cover D, gives actual global forward existence from every D point. Initial value, domain membership, within ODE for all nonnegative times and ambient ODE for all positive times are supplied in each conclusion.
